simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כָּרִי (H3746) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כָּרִי (kârîy) means a life-guardsman First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 11 4.

definitions.full: H3746. Kari כָּרִי adjective, of a people probably = Carian , only with article as substantive collective Carians , name given to foreign body-guard of king (compare RS OTJC 249, 2d ed.262 ) וְלָרָצִים לַכָּרִי 2Kin 11:4 compare 11:19 ; הכרי 2Sam 20:23 Kt (< Qr הַכְּרֵתִי which We Dr Bu prefer).
definitions.rootNote: perhaps an abridged plural of 3733 in the sense of leader (of the flock);
